protocol.comparator: unchanged old augmented J03WOH half-1 model and its unchanged decoder
protocol.decoder: pool clean training state/transition counts; add-one once; same Viterbi rule
protocol.interpretation: development comparison, not untouched test; more data includes formerly-validation J03WOH half 2; classifier and decoder both refitted
protocol.rng_policy: independent generator per scenario, restarted with seed 2028 per original half
protocol.sample_order: sorted match, period, scenario, original frame; equal weight per retained valid view sample
protocol.selection: one predeclared run; no sweep, threshold selection or automatic promotion
